tasks.subject: Task 1: Snapshot hash + corpus pin
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Canonical sha256 over the committed decoded snapshot files in fixed order (spec §3, §5.1); committed lock value patches pin and preflight compares.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["admin/pipeline/patch/snapshot.ts", "admin/pipeline/patch/snapshot.test.ts", "data/patches/snapshot.lock"], "verifyCommand": "bun test admin/pipeline/patch/snapshot.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fixed documented file list/order, source data only", "deterministic hash; lock matches fresh computation in test", "mismatch names files and points to maintenance-track rebase"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Semantic patch schema + validators
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Spec §4.3 as code: five ops with payload schemas, stable targets (marker token + content-hash anchor), occurrence assertions, ordering/overlap preflight, no-new-text validator with closed marker grammar.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["admin/pipeline/patch/schema.ts", "admin/pipeline/patch/schema.test.ts", "admin/pipeline/patch/no-new-text.ts", "admin/pipeline/patch/no-new-text.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "bun test admin/pipeline/patch/", "acceptanceCriteria": ["5 ops parse with op-specific payloads encoding sibling creation + placement", "stable target resolver, never array index, loud occurrence failures", "overlapping-target preflight error", "no-new-text rejects foreign bytes; only closed-grammar markers synthesized; reject re-dispositions needs_print_check", "accept+reject fixture per op"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Entry-result manifest
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Spec §4.4: one JSONL record per input rid, exactly one disposition, patch ids + escalation + maintainer decision slots; unresolved needs_* gate.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["admin/pipeline/research/manifest.ts", "admin/pipeline/research/manifest.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "bun test admin/pipeline/research/manifest.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["disposition enum clean/repaired/needs_print_check/needs_human_judgment", "completeness: record set == input rid set", "gate helper reports unresolved needs_* rows"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Patch apply engine + phase manifest
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Spec §5: ordered phase manifest with runtime-asserted preconditions; apply engine with all-mismatches preflight, corpus-order apply, round-trip re-parse, needs_* refusal.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["admin/pipeline/patch/apply.ts", "admin/pipeline/patch/apply.test.ts", "admin/pipeline/body/migrate-dry.ts", "package.json"], "verifyCommand": "bun test admin/pipeline/patch/apply.test.ts && bun run body:migrate-dry", "acceptanceCriteria": ["preflight: snapshot pin + every expected_before + occurrence, ALL mismatches reported together", "corpus-order apply with round-trip re-parse per structural apply", "refuses on unresolved needs_*", "phase manifest: text passes → structural → patch apply → consumer-facing, violated assertion aborts", "empty corpus keeps gates 32512/32512"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Chunker + tranche checkpoints
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Spec §4.1.2/§4.5: deterministic 20–40-entry chunks, 2–4K-entry tranches, rid checkpoints, resumable; failed run loses at most one chunk.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["admin/pipeline/research/chunks.ts", "admin/pipeline/research/chunks.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "bun test admin/pipeline/research/chunks.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["deterministic rid-ordered chunking, configurable sizes", "checkpoint records completed chunks; resume skips them (tested mid-tranche)", "chunk ids stable across runs"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Sweep prompt v1 + defect catalog (USER GATE)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Committed versioned prompt (spec §4.2) with full defect catalog, repair conventions, no-new-text constraint, output contract; doc-08 maintainer call recorded; 53 decided rows + deferred rulings carried as seed material.

**USER GATE — maintainer signs prompt v1 before any tranche runs.**

```json:metadata
{"files": ["admin/pipeline/research/prompts/sweep-v1.md", "docs/v2/body-review/08-implied-one-candidates.md", "docs/specs/2026-08-10-research-process-design.md"], "verifyCommand": "grep -c 'defect' admin/pipeline/research/prompts/sweep-v1.md", "acceptanceCriteria": ["all §4.2 elements present incl. one example per defect class", "seed decisions carried, not re-litigated", "doc-08 ruling (fold vs manual) recorded in doc-08 header + spec §8", "prompt versioned v1"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Pilot tranche + verification machinery (USER GATE)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** ~200-entry calibration tranche end-to-end with the §4.1.6 verification sampler (all low/med, random high sample, random clean sample → Opus tier); measured error + miss rates; committed output.

**USER GATE — usage go/no-go before; maintainer sets thresholds and accepts after.**

```json:metadata
{"files": ["admin/pipeline/research/verify.ts", "admin/pipeline/research/verify.test.ts", "data/patches/"], "verifyCommand": "bun test admin/pipeline/research/verify.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ingest validates schema + no-new-text before corpus entry", "sampler: all low/med + random high + random clean", "pilot report with error rate, miss rate, escalation size", "output committed; failures fold into prompt v2"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: Scaled sweep tranches (USER GATE each)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Full-corpus sweep in fixed-size tranches, each manually gated on usage windows, each committed before the next; threshold breaches halt promotion and re-sweep affected chunks.

**USER GATE — go/no-go per tranche, manual by design.**

```json:metadata
{"files": ["data/patches/"], "verifyCommand": "bun test admin/pipeline/research/manifest.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["per tranche: go/no-go → sweep → ingest → verification within thresholds → commit", "breach halts promotion, feeds catalog, re-sweeps chunks", "final manifest complete: one record per corpus rid (32512)"], "userGate": true, "tags": ["user-gate"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 9: Synthesis + script extraction loop
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Corpus-wide synthesis (cross-entry patterns feed catalog + re-sweeps); script→re-run→recompute-redundancy→retire loop until stable; redundancy only on post-state equality, mismatch routes to review.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["admin/pipeline/research/synthesis.ts", "admin/pipeline/patch/redundancy.ts", "admin/pipeline/patch/redundancy.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "bun test admin/pipeline/patch/redundancy.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["synthesis report: class counts + cross-entry patterns", "redundancy rule in code: retire only on post-state equality", "loop stable; residue documented"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 10: Recounts + evidence docs (USER GATE)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Recounts at target (brokenTopSequences=0, startsAtTwo=0) or enumerated signed sets; docs match measured output; follow-on plans (print tier, maintenance track) stubbed.

**USER GATE — maintainer signs the final numbers.**
